- id: plan-mode
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
  config:
    section: >
      You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until the user approves your plan
      through exit_plan_mode or switches the session mode. Imperative language
      to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A
      user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something
      you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the
      confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.


      Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and
      checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write
      files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that
      rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer
      existing functions and patterns over new machinery.


      The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability.
      These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that
      suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed only to keep the
      request shape stable. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase:
      it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself
      belongs in exit_plan_mode.


      Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for
      user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do
      not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you
      can find out.


      Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria;
      group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema,
      and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance
      criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but
      detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making
      design decisions.


      When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting
      with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that
      assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation
      begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as
      a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or
      ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and
      present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in
      plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with
      implementation.
  disabled: true

                Imperative language to implement changes means plan the
                implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational
                agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked —
                approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed
                decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.


                Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static
                analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual
                repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration,
                run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files,
                commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing
                functions and patterns over new machinery.


                The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache
                stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool
                description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools;
                those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do
                not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks
                implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself
                belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that
                inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives
                or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify
                public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases,
                failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit
                assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed
                enough that another engineer can implement it without making
                design decisions.

                tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for

                mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed

- id: preset-building-loop
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
  config:
    id: building-loop
    name: building-loop
    description: >-
      派单协作模式——派单方下任务单→接单会话执行→回帖交付与验收。文件即事实源：身份与职责来自工作区
      AGENTS.md，按当前步骤按需装填技能与指令，盲区必先查证不瞎说。
    order: 9
    plugins:
      - id: persona
        name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
        config:
          prefix: >-
            You are an agent working in building-loop (dispatch mode). Working
            directory: {{cwd}}. Core discipline — files are the single source of
            truth: your identity and duties come from the workspace AGENTS.md
            and the files it points to, never from memory. Iron rules: 1) On
            session start, read the workspace AGENTS.md first. 2) Load
            skills/instruction files for the current step on demand (环节装填); on
            knowledge gaps, search/verify first — never confidently state
            unverified claims (不瞎说铁律). 3) Delivery format: one compact report
            with position+change+measured evidence; resolve pending items
            immediately (挂账最少化 — no accumulating backlog) — stop and ask the
            user only for direction-choice questions, with a recommendation
            attached. 4) Scope clause: do not touch files outside your assigned
            scope; report errors to the coordinator instead of fixing them on
            the side. 5) Context survival: before reading large files, estimate
            their total size against the session budget and read them in
            batches, summarising each batch to key points before the next;
            compress proactively (compress tool) rather than waiting for forced
            truncation; keep single-turn thinking+output inside a hard budget.
            6) Acceptance must be runnable: state the exact command and its
            expected output, and prefer runnable checks over descriptive ones;
            self-verification means actually running every runnable check and
            attaching the real output — "confirmed/done" is not evidence; when
            you are on the receiving side, re-run a sample of the deterministic
            checks and compare, and treat a mismatch as an automatic rejection.
            7) Never self-select your own audit sample: samples come from the
            dispatching side or from physical randomness (e.g. a random line of
            an artifact list), never from the party being checked — selection
            bias is where corruption starts. 8) Bound the blast radius: land a
            rollback point before modifying anything and record where it is;
            when a unit fails, roll back only that unit, never redo or roll back
            neighbouring units to compensate. 9) Do not let verification share
            the author's blind spots: for high-impact or irreversible
            deliveries, re-check with a different origin — a differently-sourced
            model, or a deterministic tool deriving the key numbers
            independently — rather than another instance of the same lineage.
            10) Run work as task slips and receipts: load the
            `dispatch-protocol` and `project-index` skills, and follow their
            slip template, receipt template, state machine and ledger format. A
            slip names its ledger path — if the project names none, ask before
            creating one. A workspace-root DISPATCH.md, when present, is
            injected automatically and binds the project's own names; it wins
            over these defaults. When the project carries an index, read its

            its evidence, its report — before opening the next, instead of
            starting several and landing none. If the output limit cuts you off,
            stop at a boundary between units and say what is still owed; a
            half-written unit is not a delivery. 12) Dispatch first: as soon as
            a task arrives, load the `dispatch-protocol` skill and turn the work
            into task slips — dispatch to subagents before doing the work
            yourself. A coordinator's own hands are for coordination, review,
            and the few non-delegable steps; grinding the whole task inline is
            not what this mode does. Until `dispatch-protocol` is loaded, do not
            start executing the task itself. Creative judgment follows your
            workspace files; mechanical steps follow this mode.

reviewer.method: Read the listed frozen implementation and positive/negative test source, inspect parent-captured regression evidence, compare SHA-256. This reviewer did not execute/import protected source or tests.

scope: 85-to-93 precise rejected spans and cited-range evidence baselines
Same-line correct prefix, genuine correction/scope/denial/error-example, source-only repair
Unrelated source edits, shifted ranges, current actual source reads and explicit legacy limits
Classification reconciliation reasons, no proof leakage or stale reason
Parent-added final real-run false rejection: explicit error labels with bounded parenthesized descriptions and ordinal combinations

initialFrozen93.verdictAt93: Three mechanical gaps found despite 93 passing tests. Parent explicitly required fixes and independent final review before the final paid pair; already-started 93-version runs are retained unchanged.

findings.title: Classification reason remained visible after material invalidation or real factual rejection

initialEvidence.supports: Notice checked only persisted reconciliation presence
Coordinator prepare had no assignment spec and skipped binding refresh
Coordinator status returned viewUnits without refreshing binding
A reviewer factual rejection entered supplement-ready without clearing reconciliation

initialCounterexamples: After a real classification dispute, change candidate/goal/source/instructions; call coordinator status or prepare before advance. Old classification-reconciliation remains visible.
Reconciled reviewer supplies a real unsupported factual finding and returns supplement-ready. Old reconciliation remains, with a misleading reviewer/supplement next-role pair.
findings.initialValidation: Static source trace; reviewer did not execute protected tests.
findings.finalChange: The notice now accepts only actual review/audit phases and compares the current material binding before exposing a reason. A real author-facing factual rejection retires both private checkpoints, the reconciliation/binding, restored binding and pending receipt.

finalEvidence.supports: Same host-only binding for current notices; phase and binding checks without exposing proof
Factual rejection clears the old classification branch
Normal structured reason, no proof content, own-checkpoint reuse, resolution clears notices and ledger basis reminder
Immediate status/prepare after all four material changes; actual factual rejection leaves supplement next step and clears all old private fields

findings.title: A fence line with non-whitespace trailing text incorrectly closed a code block

initialEvidence.supports: Matching fence character/length was sufficient to close, without checking trailing text

initialCounterexample: 大白话：仍在代码围栏内。
findings.initialConsequence: The apparent closing fence is code content, so the final label remains inside code. The 93-version scanner incorrectly treated it as an outside closing paragraph.
findings.initialValidation: Static source trace; reviewer did not execute protected tests.
findings.finalChange: A closing fence must use the matching fence character, sufficient length and whitespace-only trailing content. Invalid closer lines keep the scanner inside the code block.

finalEvidence.supports: Strict closing fence check before recognizing a closing explanation
Backtick and tilde invalid closer rejection; real whitespace-only closer permits outside explanation

findings.title: Same-paragraph soft line wrapping hid an unchanged rejected quote

initialEvidence.supports: Occurrence search ran independently per physical line
No occurrence was classified as removed-or-rewritten

initialCounterexamples: Original: 全部20项均通过. New: 全部20项\n均通过 with no blank paragraph and no new evidence.
List continuation: - 全部20项\n  均通过.
findings.initialConsequence: The candidate hash changed while the factual assertion and evidence did not, permitting preflight to be skipped through formatting alone.
findings.initialValidation: Static source trace; reviewer did not execute protected tests.
findings.followupDuringReview: The first 97-test candidate still isolated four-space/Tab continuation lines even inside a nonempty paragraph. Reviewer reported this same-gap variant; final code treats those as soft continuation when a paragraph is active and preserves indented code only across a real boundary.
findings.finalChange: Paragraph-aware matching joins only contiguous prose/list continuation rows, retains physical row mapping and searches the normalized actual rejected quote across soft wraps. Blank paragraphs, headings, new list items and quote/table/HTML/code boundaries are not joined. Every retained occurrence still needs withdrawal, permitted scope repair or currently read changed cited content.

finalEvidence.supports: Paragraph grouping, actual Markdown continuation handling and physical start/end row mapping
All retained occurrences are evaluated and unresolved physical rows returned
Production submit rejects plain/list/four-space/Tab unchanged soft wrap; actual denial/example/new evidence remains reviewable, no joining separate structure blocks

findings.title: Explicit error labels with parenthesized descriptions caused avoidable author rework
findings.source: Parent-added final scope from a real 93-version DSH run; no new broad audit

initialEvidence.supports: Original B32 block visibly begins - 错例（字段混滑）： but inventory marks asserted-unless-nonfactual
Reviewer submits error-example with explicit description label; host returns the literal-label error
Same label error occurs again during the later record attempt

findings.observedText: - 错例（字段混滑）：记录 A 已完成，所以记录 A 必定成功——错在把 status=completed 当成 conclusion=success；
findings.initialConsequence: A visibly marked teaching example was treated as unlabelled. The retained run later rewrote the label to 错例：. Root identified the extra author-repair cycle; this reviewer confirms the original label and host rejection from raw events and does not independently attribute a precise token amount to this label error.
findings.initialValidation: Read-only inspection of raw recorded DSH events and the old shared label grammar; no paid calls or replay by this reviewer.

"""Replay the same production footnote fixture against 0.7.6 and the current runtime."""

from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import json
import shutil
import subprocess


stage = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = stage.parent / 'building-loop'
baseline = '936df4323aecdc893cdf1e206b5ffce074765e59'
selection = 'a unique touching footnote binds its own source'
test = 'test/source-observation.test.mjs'
modules = ('governance/preflight.mjs', 'governance/coverage.mjs', 'governance/goals.mjs')


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repo), *args])


def observe(root, *args):
    result = subprocess.run(['node', '--test', *args, test], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8')
    return {'exitCode': result.returncode, 'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr,
            'runtimeHashes': {name: sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in modules}}


with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='dsh-r077-footnote-replay-') as directory:
    checkout = Path(directory)
    for name in git('ls-tree', '--name-only', '-r', baseline, 'governance/').decode().splitlines():
        if name.endswith('.mjs'):
            target = checkout / name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(git('show', baseline + ':' + name))
    for name in ('test/helpers.mjs', test):
        target = checkout / name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(repo / name, target)
    before = observe(checkout, '--test-name-pattern=' + selection)
    # The 0.7.6 matcher finds the unrelated same-line source, so it advances
    # instead of rejecting the explicit but incorrectly attributed footnote.
    assert before['exitCode'] == 1 and 'first-audit-ready' in before['stdout'] and 'supplement-ready' in before['stdout']

after = observe(repo)
assert after['exitCode'] == 0, after
report = dict(passed=True, baselineCommit=baseline, testPath=test, selectedBaselineCase=selection,
              fixtureSha256=sha256((repo / test).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), old=before, current=after,
              evidenceScope='Registered production tool handlers in an isolated scripted fixture. No paid model request or general Markdown coverage claim.')
(stage / 'r077-footnote-replay.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n').encode())
print('Baseline incorrectly advanced the wrong attribution; current full quotation suite passed.')

# 检查结果与观测说明

**检查结果字段**
- C1：GitHub 的 completed 状态可以对应 failure 结论（出处：sources/github-checks.md 第 6-8 行）。
- C4：GitHub 登记原文在第 6 行列出的结论例子有 failure 与 success 两项（出处：sources/github-checks.md 第 6-8 行）。
- [模拟] 本例记录 A 为 status=completed、conclusion=failure（出处：sources/synthetic.md 第 2 行）。

**相关与因果**
- C2：NIST 指出，相关不必然说明因果（出处：sources/nist-scatter.md 第 6 行）。
- [模拟] 就 sources/synthetic.md 的模拟观测记录而言，只能报告相关，不能单凭该记录确定因果（出处：sources/synthetic.md 第 3 行；sources/nist-scatter.md 第 6 行）。
- 该模拟观测组的训练时长与分数正相关，不能因此推出延长训练必然提高每个人的分数（出处：sources/synthetic.md 第 3 行）。
- [推测] 后续可以考虑通过更合适的研究设计检验原因。

**有限规则推导**
- C3：按本例规则，样本 X 是 A 级，因此样本 X 应送复核（出处：sources/synthetic.md 第 4-5 行）。
- 本稿规则只支持由 A 级推出应送复核，不能由此反推出任何送复核的样本都是 A 级（出处：sources/synthetic.md 第 4-5 行）。
- [模拟] 按本例规则只能由 A 级推出应送复核，不能反推，所以样本 X 应送复核并不能说明其他送复核的样本也是 A 级（出处：sources/synthetic.md 第 4-5 行）。
- [模拟] 按本例规则只能由 A 级推出应送复核，不能反推，所以样本 X 应送复核也不能说明其他送复核的样本不是 A 级（出处：sources/synthetic.md 第 4-5 行）。

错例：记录 A 已完成，所以记录 A 必定成功（出处：sources/synthetic.md 第 2 行）。

- [稿件自述] 行号定位 8 行：带 sources/synthetic.md 的行号定位为第 6,10,11,15,16,17,18,20 行；同带 [模拟] 4 行：第 6,10,17,18 行。

import shutil
import subprocess

repo = folder.parent / 'building-loop'

    with tarfile.open(fileobj=BytesIO(archive)) as source:

    isolated = Path(directory)

    run = subprocess.run(['node','--test','--test-name-pattern='+pattern,*tests], cwd=isolated,

data.scope: R18 bound arithmetic, observed excerpt boundaries, and unit interruption ownership
data.status: no blocker in the reviewed scope
findings: A pre-release acceptedVersion path allowed a prior calculation proof to bypass the stronger assertion binding. Reproduced before the repair, then verified against the revised source and tests for both reviewer roles and ledger-review/closed. Correct legacy proof stays readable without a historical rewrite or a wider coordinator grant.

Separate acquired excerpts can be cited individually. A combined quotation cannot turn them into continuous external prose, and a locator to editorial metadata can be returned to the author. Missing reads and damaged acquisition receipts remain verification-side errors.

An observed unit interruption reuses the host item for its owner. A second coordinator cannot obtain it, and a duplicate entry or revision is not created. Export includes the last host-observed interruption.
data.limit: Read-only source and test review. Execution evidence is in the root-captured regression and native model runs; no claim of general semantic truth.

data.method: Read-only evaluation of real completed first reviews while runs continued. Both summary and ledger-state writes intercepted; no live run modified. No claim of final acceptance or final usage totals.

## 代码和实际行为共同支持的成因

引用均为该运行 `isolated-home/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-building-loop/governance/` 下封存代码，而非后来修改的 staging。

| 机制 | 代码位置 | 已观察到的后果与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 标点分块保持全文覆盖，但并不等于语义分句。 | `coverage.mjs:20–30`，句号/分号切块。 | R:L15 的括号内引用被分号切出 B14；F 的六条“出处”被句号切成独立块；F:L16 的推测标记与“尚未验证”被分号分开。覆盖没有遗漏，但引文、限定与其对象关系需保留。 |
| 分类比较只把 D/I 记为事实掩码，逐字符取对称差。 | `coverage.mjs:493–515`。 | 一方整块 I、另一方标签 N＋正文 I 时，连纯标签都变成待核事实；一方整块 E、另一方错例 E＋解释 D 时，解释进入争议。这些是不同粒度，不等于来源内容相反。两位 E 对 `contradicts/insufficient` 的真正差异不在这项检查范围。 |
| 争议只能用 D/I 覆盖，或明确 block 待裁定；没有“确认此段只是标签/定位”的结构化结案出口。 | `coverage.mjs:522–531`；`index.mjs:501–509` 恢复本人旧证明后移除全部争议块。 | R:1246 真实拒绝两个前缀 N，随后把整个块改 D/I 才收下；该机制能拦原样降级，也会把已经准确核过的同块内容一并重写。程序没有要求编证据，错误提示明示可 block；本次模型仍填了不实/不相干证据。 |
| 外部原文取证规则未区分稿件、项目状态和登记范围的证据类型。 | `evidence.mjs:61–77`；`observedExcerpt` 的 `18–45`；`coverage.mjs:47–56`、`232–238`；两组配置 `/units/K01/phases/final-review/evidence` 仅列 G/N/S。 | 候选可以读，却不在 evidence 授权；source-checks 是宿主取得回执，未授予模型作为普通 evidence；G/N:4 被正确挡在外部原文之外。但 D 对自述仍走同一引用入口，出现用 G:6 支持“本节只是说明”、用 S:3 支持“项目未验证”。应增加受限证据域/宿主属性凭据，不能放松“说明不是外部原文”的规则。 |

### 尚须解决，不能靠统一枚举消除

1. **证明自身也须可证伪。** R:1251 / 当前 B5 basis 的“该文件无 GitHub 字样”已被 N:4 直接推翻；该错误发生在本次分类修正中，不能记成修好了。候选的“本轮已登记原文缺源”仍成立，两件事分开。
2. **证据必须和问题属于同一范围。** R B18 需当前稿件章节；R B20 需快照结构和登记属性；F B22 需项目验证记录的明确范围。G/N/S 的真实原句不能自动证明这些属性。当前两位“都支持”不增加外部证据。
3. **错例标签不能吞掉作者的正确解释，也不能把证据不足写成相反事实。** R B10–B12 的解释仍需核；R B12 的 `contradicts` 应单独处理。R B11 应明确判的是推导有效性还是实际效果，不能混写。
4. **摘要可复用事实证明，不能靠“没有新事实”免核。** R B24 最新登记结构化引文不齐；F B29 则已挂对应三组证据。二者不能同样说成只差标签、也不能一律重跑全文。

可确定性处理的部分包括：纯前缀位置、引文文件/行号/哈希、登记摘录集合、当前稿件范围，以及已有证明的版本依赖。结论是否被证据支持、限定词是否改变范围，仍需独立语义核验或明确保留不确定。**这两次实测支持“分类粒度与证据域不匹配造成返工”，不支持“同一模型一定会错”或“只要统一提示词就解决”的唯一因果判断。** 两组 runtime coverage 哈希不同，且两组核验/反证各自仍复用原角色会话；`fresh` 是执行者补查换新，不是每次核验都新开。

data.changes: Only added independent review files. Original events, candidate, receipts, sources and host state unchanged.

reviewer.method: Read frozen production source, positive and negative test source, and root-captured regression output; independently compare file SHA-256 values. No protected source was imported or executed by this reviewer.

scope: Explicitly authorized ledgerDocument host export: complete owned IDs, statuses, evidence and revision
Owner isolation and model read/write authorization
Export failure and host-state commit failure must not return a successfully closed workflow
unlisted repair debt must align with actual rejected factual finding spans
Generalized explicit numbered error-example labels, with counterevidence and negative controls

decision.statement: The three defects found during this read-only review have corresponding frozen fixes and targeted regression cases. No new blocking defect was found in the requested third-batch scope. This is not a claim of universal semantic correctness or power-loss-safe multi-file atomicity.

testEvidence.executor: parent/root independent capture, not this reviewer
testEvidence.limits: This reviewer inspected the captured test evidence and test code rather than rerunning the suite. Parent reported a separate 15/15 keyless native probe; that report is not used as independently inspected evidence here. No new paid DSH run is included in this review.

resolvedFindings.title: Shared ledger projection metadata could reveal another coordinator's private ledger IDs
resolvedFindings.before: The workspace state has one ledgerProjection slot. read returned that slot without checking owner, although the item list was owner-filtered. Export A, export B, then read as A could return B's itemIds.
resolvedFindings.after: read returns projection only if both its owner and configured path match the caller. Explicit foreign unit reads are rejected; exported items and current units are independently owner-filtered.

evidence.supports: Owner filtering of ledger items, including export's includeClosed=true view
Export filters all current items and units to the calling coordinator
Foreign explicit unit rejection and owner/path projection filter
Two owners, separate plans, successive export, absent foreign metadata and rejected foreign checkpoint read

resolvedFindings.boundary: The configured ledgerDocument is a shared project path and contains the last exporting owner's snapshot. An actor with explicit file-read authorization can read that shared file. The fix isolates ledger API state; it does not claim file-level privacy between actors authorized to the same document.

resolvedFindings.title: A correct prefix of a compound factual part could become author repair debt
resolvedFindings.before: unlisted was allowed anywhere in a rejected direct/inference part, even when finding.quote identified only its incorrect suffix. Example: 本例通过19项，全部20项均通过 with finding.quote=全部20项均通过 could incorrectly reject 本例通过19项.
resolvedFindings.after: Each rejected interval is now the uniquely located finding.quote inside its factual part. Every non-whitespace character of unlisted.quote must belong to those rejected intervals. Ambiguous or nonmatching metadata stays with the reviewer. review rechecks the metadata after a coverage update.

evidence.supports: Unique line quote, unique factual finding quote, exact interval coverage and metadata error
Revalidation at review against the final coverage snapshot
Reject headings/hypotheses/error-examples as debt, accept real factual heading, reject stale metadata after coverage becomes supported
Correct prefix is rejected as metadata; actual incorrect suffix proceeds to supplement-ready

resolvedFindings.boundary: The host proves agreement between metadata and recorded factual findings. It does not itself determine whether a reviewer has classified an arbitrary sentence correctly; the independent semantic review and audit remain necessary.

resolvedFindings.title: A successful external ledger write followed by failed host-state persistence could leave a closed document and open host state
resolvedFindings.before: exportLedger wrote ledgerDocument before change committed the host state. If state persistence failed, the generated document could show a revision and closed phase that had never committed.
resolvedFindings.after: Only the new ledger export supplies a rollback list to replaceWithHistory. Each successfully completed write appends an inverse operation with the exact expected written bytes. change reverses those operations on operation, state-backup or state-write errors. Recovery conflicts are reported as AggregateError and never returned as successful closure.

evidence.supports: Ledger export opts into compensation before publishing projection metadata
Expected prior-byte comparison, same-directory staged write and replacement
Record only successful writes; include document, log, rolling document backup and rolling log backup
Host commit followed by error compensation in reverse order, with explicit recovery failure reporting
Export path failure leaves ledger-review and running disposition unchanged; later recovery succeeds
Injected host-state rename failure verifies original host state and all four exported document/history/backup byte sequences, then a successful retry closes

resolvedFindings.boundary: Compensation is in memory and handles catchable errors. No durable multi-file journal exists for process termination or power loss. External concurrent edits can cause the expected-byte recovery check to fail; that condition is explicitly reported, requires reconciliation and is not silently overwritten. The concurrent-edit failure branch was inspected statically but has no separate injected regression in this captured batch.

acceptanceMatrix.requirement: Complete current owned IDs, statuses, revision and evidence
acceptanceMatrix.details: Export uses ledgerSummary(true), so finished items remain included. It emits owner, global ledger revision, status counts, current unit phase/receipt, every stable item ID and status, disposition basis/outcome/checkpoint, evidence path/range/hash, coverage receipt/candidate/goal hashes, origin session/event/hash and timestamp. The test captures a late user request and checks all seven IDs, count, revision, backup and idempotence. Evidence formatting was verified from source; the seven-item test does not individually assert every evidence field.

acceptanceMatrix.requirement: Explicit authorization and model read-only projection
acceptanceMatrix.details: ledgerDocument must be a safe exact coordinator.write path and cannot overlap goals, context evidence, instructions, candidates or receipts. It is removed from all model write scopes and has a specific write-handler rejection. Only the coordinator ledger action can export. The policy's write permission authorizes host generation, not model-authored replacements. Without explicit configuration the legacy narrative remains untouched and host state remains authoritative.

acceptanceMatrix.requirement: Closure remains tied to current evidence and complete decisions
acceptanceMatrix.details: Fresh ledger revision/serial read, current goal/candidate acceptance, authorized actually read context and exact decision coverage remain required. Standalone plans cannot borrow completed status from an unrelated receipt. covered requires a current owned accepted replacing unit. review exports the final dispositions inside the same change operation before a successful return. Captured tests include goal changes, stale closure, late messages and unrelated completion rejection.

acceptanceMatrix.requirement: Generalized numbered error-example labels without weakening source checks
acceptanceMatrix.details: NFKC normalization plus conservative leading Markdown presentation removal supports Arabic/Chinese/fullwidth ordinals, brackets and emphasis around visible error labels. Original bytes remain the coverage/quotation basis. Each error-example still requires a visible local label, actual authorized source quote and contradicts/insufficient relation, then becomes illustrated-error rather than a supported premise. Positive tests cover 12 label forms and replay the three original status/correlation/reverse-implication examples. Negative tests reject negated labels, mere mentions, unlabelled assertions and borrowing a preceding heading's label.

remainingBoundariesAndFollowUps.description: No cross-process crash recovery journal. Do not describe the export plus host state as power-loss-safe atomic multi-file transaction.
remainingBoundariesAndFollowUps.suggestedClaim: Catchable write failures trigger version-checked in-process compensation; recovery conflicts are reported explicitly.

remainingBoundariesAndFollowUps.overallRequestedSubmissionContract: Not yet fully met for unchanged unnumbered findings after an irrelevant edit on the same line. Parent has authorized a narrow follow-up fix; this report preserves the 85-test frozen state and does not mark that future fix complete.
remainingBoundariesAndFollowUps.description: Unnumbered supplement preflight still compares the complete original line. Changing only a correct prefix on the same line can defeat the unchanged-line hint while retaining the actual rejected clause. This does not bypass the mandatory later independent full-coverage review, but it can waste a final-review round. The third-batch unlisted alignment fix does not resolve this older preflight limitation.
remainingBoundariesAndFollowUps.suggestion: A future repair contract should compare the rejected quote plus current evidence, not just entire-line identity, while allowing genuine new supporting evidence and avoiding forced edits to a correct prefix. Add both irrelevant-prefix-edit and evidence-only valid-repair controls before claiming strict submission prevention.
remainingBoundariesAndFollowUps.validation: Static counterexample; not executed by this read-only reviewer. Parent and implementation agent notified before this report.

remainingBoundariesAndFollowUps.description: The visible-label parser intentionally recognizes a finite unambiguous grammar, not arbitrary natural-language author intent. The structural gates require real quoted evidence and independent semantic review; they do not prove that arbitrary quoted evidence actually entails or contradicts an assertion. Unrecognized presentation should stay in review as a classification issue rather than be claimed universally supported.

The exported file is complete for the exporting owner at the export checkpoint, not an aggregate of all owners or a write-through mirror after every ledger mutation. One configured path holds the most recent owner's snapshot; owner and revision are explicit. Subsequent record calls need a later export/review for a fresh document.

"""Exercise the independent verifier without importing project modules or APIs."""
from collections import Counter
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import copy
import json
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
HOME = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
VERIFIER = ROOT / "work/building-loop-efficiency-stage/package/experiments/verify.py"
EXPORTER = VERIFIER.with_name("archive.py")


def encoded(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")


# Extract only the exporter's audited pure aggregation function. Its output is
# the value under test; the verifier runs in another process and imports neither
# this helper nor the exporter. No product module or launcher is executed here.
node = next(n for n in ast.parse(EXPORTER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "usage")
scope = {"Counter": Counter}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node], type_ignores=[]), "<exporter usage only>", "exec"), scope)
exporter_usage = scope["usage"]


def artifact(path, name):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    text = raw.decode("utf-8-sig")
    kind, data = "text", text
    if path.suffix == ".json":
        kind, data = "json", json.loads(text)
    elif path.suffix == ".jsonl":
        kind, data = "jsonl", [json.loads(x) for x in text.splitlines() if x.strip()]
    return dict(path=name, kind=kind, originalSha256=sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                publishedSha256=sha256(encoded(data)).hexdigest(), data=data)


def bundle(run):
    files = [p for p in run.iterdir() if p.is_file()]
    for directory in ("calls", "scores", "requests"):
        if (run / directory).is_dir():
            files += list((run / directory).rglob("*.json"))
    return dict(spec="building-loop-experiment/1", family=run.parent.name, run=run.name,
                artifacts=[artifact(p, p.relative_to(run).as_posix()) for p in sorted(files)])


def find(bundle, path):
    return next(a["data"] for a in bundle["artifacts"] if a["path"] == path)


def remove(bundle, path):
    bundle["artifacts"] = [a for a in bundle["artifacts"] if a["path"] != path]


def publish(directory, bundles):
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    index = dict(spec="building-loop-experiments/1", runs=[])
    for item in bundles:
        for a in item["artifacts"]:
            a["publishedSha256"] = sha256(encoded(a["data"])).hexdigest()
        item["recordedUsage"] = exporter_usage(item["artifacts"])
        path = item["family"] + "/" + item["run"] + ".json"
        raw = encoded(item)
        target = directory / path
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes(raw)
        index["runs"].append(dict(path=path, sha256=sha256(raw).hexdigest(), bytes=len(raw), recordedUsage=item["recordedUsage"]))
    smoke = encoded(dict(spec="building-loop-smoke/1", artifacts=[]))
    (directory / "standalone-smoke.json").write_bytes(smoke)
    index["smoke"] = dict(path="standalone-smoke.json", sha256=sha256(smoke).hexdigest(), bytes=len(smoke), artifacts=0)
    (directory / "index.json").write_bytes(encoded(index))


def trial(name, bundles, success, expected=None):
    directory = HOME / "cases" / name
    publish(directory, bundles)
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", str(VERIFIER), str(directory),
                             "--report", str(HOME / "results" / (name + ".json"))],
                            text=True, capture_output=True, encoding="utf-8")
    okay = (result.returncode == 0) == success and (not expected or expected in result.stderr)
    item = dict(name=name, expectedPass=success, pass_=okay, exitCode=result.returncode,
                stdout=result.stdout.strip(), stderr=result.stderr.strip())
    results.append(item)
    if not okay:
        raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False))


causal = bundle(ROOT / "outputs/building-loop-causal-audit/20261107T143055Z")
followup = bundle(ROOT / "outputs/building-loop-causal-audit/20261107T154044Z")
sample = bundle(ROOT / "outputs/building-loop-threshold-audit/20261107T143433Z-A-unbounded")
formal = [bundle(ROOT / "outputs/building-loop-threshold-audit" / name) for name in
          ("20261107T144343Z-A-500000", "20261107T144917Z-B-unbounded")]
results = []
trial("real-direct-runs", copy.deepcopy([causal, sample, *formal]), True)

b = copy.deepcopy(sample)
remove(b, "response-001.json")

b = copy.deepcopy(sample)

calls[1]["attempts"][0]["response"]["id"] = calls[0]["attempts"][0]["response"]["id"]
calls[1]["response"]["id"] = calls[0]["attempts"][0]["response"]["id"]

trial("duplicate-attempt", [b], False, "missing/duplicate attempt")
b = copy.deepcopy(causal)
call = next(a["data"] for a in b["artifacts"] if a["path"].startswith("calls/"))

trial("top-level-usage-copy", [b], False, "top-level response/usage differs")
b = copy.deepcopy(causal)
call_path = next(a["path"] for a in b["artifacts"] if a["path"].startswith("calls/prep-"))
remove(b, call_path)
trial("missing-preparation-call", [b], False, "summary call counts differ")

# A genuine failed request with no returned usage remains an explicitly unknown
# attempt. It must neither be rejected as corruption nor be called zero tokens.
b = copy.deepcopy(sample)

ev = find(b, "events.jsonl")[0]["data"]

# A request saved immediately before interruption is listed separately as

b = copy.deepcopy(sample)

request["path"] = "request-002.json"

trial("pending-request-retained", [b], True)

# The later diagnostic has its own sealed 8-call / 32-document schema. Keep the
# legacy positive and negative cases above unchanged while adding this shape.
trial("followup-real-eight-calls", [copy.deepcopy(followup)], True)
b = copy.deepcopy(followup)
first_call = next(a for a in b["artifacts"] if a["path"].startswith("calls/"))

summary.update(allCalls=7, matrixRows=7)
totals = Counter(calls=7)
for call in remaining:
    for attempt in call["attempts"]:
        totals["attempts"] += 1
        for key in ("totalTokens", "promptTokens", "outputTokens", "cacheReadTokens", "uncachedInputTokens", "estimatedUSD"):
            totals[key] += attempt["usage"][key]
summary["totals"] = dict(totals)
find(b, "finished.json").update(allCalls=7, rows=7)
trial("followup-coherently-missing-call", [b], False, "completed follow-up lacks planned calls")
b = copy.deepcopy(followup)
call = next(a["data"] for a in b["artifacts"] if a["path"].startswith("calls/"))
call["metadata"]["kind"] = "unrecognized-judgment"
trial("followup-unknown-kind", [b], False, "unknown causal call kind")
b = copy.deepcopy(followup)
call = next(a["data"] for a in b["artifacts"] if a["path"].startswith("calls/"))
duplicate = copy.deepcopy(call["attempts"][0])
duplicate["attempt"] = 2
call["attempts"].append(duplicate)
trial("followup-duplicate-metered-response", [b], False, "duplicate provider response ID")
b = copy.deepcopy(followup)
call = next(a["data"] for a in b["artifacts"] if a["path"].startswith("calls/"))
body = json.loads(call["request"]["messages"][-1]["content"])
